natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for the ERC-20 Wrapper extension — records the underlying token (caching its decimals) and registers IERC20Wrapper via ERC-165. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} (through {MultiInit}) inside the initializing window opened by the diamond, alongside the base {ERC20Init}; it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer. Reverts with {IERC20Wrapper-ERC20InvalidUnderlying} when `underlying_` is the wrapper itself.
